# Story Time: There can only be h1 tag!

#### Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage

## Story Time: There can only be h1 tag!

Back when I was a student learning HTML for the first time, I created a simple web page for my assignment and showed it to my instructor.

I was rather proud of my work, but the instructor raised his eyebrow and scolded me for using multiple <h1> tags.

"The h1 tag is the title of the page, boy! And a page can only ever have a single title. Google won't like what you did here!"

That scolding was the price I paid for not paying attention in class 😅
